items.title: Register the parallel-decomposition gate on all four DEV-entry transitions in lifecycle-registry.ts LIFECYCLE_TRANSITIONS
items.context: core/lifecycle-registry.ts: add a parallel-decomposition gate id (e.g. 'parallel-decomposition') to the gates metadata of the INIT_CHECK->DEV, PLAN->DEV, REVIEW->DEV, and TEST->DEV transitions, matching the runtime guards (canSkipPlanGuard/canStartDevGuard/canReenterDevGuard). Match the existing gate-id naming/shape used by sibling gates (e.g. cwd-worktree, plan-review, scope-check).

happy.desc: the LIFECYCLE_TRANSITIONS gates arrays for the four START->DEV doors (INIT_CHECK/PLAN/REVIEW/TEST) each include a parallel-decomposition gate id; WHY: the metadata records the gate on exactly the runtime doors

edge.desc: no OTHER to:DEV lifecycle transition (the gates:[] entries ~247/269) gains the gate unless it maps to a real runtime START->DEV door; WHY: do not invent doors the runtime does not guard

adversarial.desc: lattice validate stays all-green and the integration smoke is unchanged -> runtime behavior provably unchanged by the metadata edit; WHY: metadata-only, no enforcement change

verificationEvidence.note: lifecycle-registry.ts gates arrays for INIT_CHECK/PLAN/REVIEW/TEST->DEV now include 'parallel-decomposition'; the extended drift check asserts the registration (passes).
the two legacy TEST_CASE->DEV / TEST_CASE_REVIEW->DEV entries (gates:[]) were left untouched — only the 4 runtime doors registered.
lattice validate all green incl. the unchanged 50-assertion integration smoke -> runtime behavior provably unchanged by the metadata edit.

items.title: Register the parallel DEV-entry gate as a consumer of scope-contract facts in process-fact-levels.ts
items.context: core/process-fact-levels.ts: scope_contract_set / scope_contract_init_from_plan facts currently list REVIEW/TEST/DONE changed-file gates as consumers; add the parallel DEV-entry gate (machine.ts consumes scope contracts before every DEV entry) as an L4 consumer, matching the existing consumer-registration shape.

happy.desc: process-fact-levels.ts lists the parallel DEV-entry gate as a consumer of scope-contract facts (matching the existing consumer-registration shape); WHY: machine.ts consumes scope contracts before every DEV entry

edge.desc: the consumer registration uses the existing L4/consumer form and does not alter other fact consumers; WHY: additive, no regression to other facts

adversarial.desc: the existing process-fact contract assertions still pass (no existing fact broken); WHY: additive change

verificationEvidence.note: process-fact-levels.ts gateConsumer of the scope_contract L4 facts now names the parallel-decomposition DEV-entry gate; drift check passes.
additive gateConsumer string extension matching the existing free-text shape; other fact consumers unchanged.
the existing process-fact contract assertions still pass (no existing fact broken).

items.title: Extend verify-process-fact-contract.mjs to assert the new parallel DEV-entry guard surface
items.context: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs (run via npm --prefix . run test:process-fact-contract; not in lattice validate): add assertions that the parallel DEV-entry gate (canSkipPlan / canReenterDev / parallelDevEntryBlock) is registered as a scope-contract-fact consumer, so future divergence between machine.ts and the metadata is caught. The check must pass after the CHK-001/002 updates.

happy.desc: npm --prefix . run test:process-fact-contract passes WITH a new assertion that the parallel DEV-entry gate (canSkipPlan/canReenterDev/parallelDevEntryBlock) is registered as a scope-contract-fact consumer; WHY: the gate is now mechanically protected from drift

edge.desc: the new assertion reads the ACTUAL registration (not a constant) and FAILS if the parallel gate is removed from the metadata; WHY: a tautological assertion gives false confidence

adversarial.desc: temporarily removing the registration makes test:process-fact-contract FAIL, then restoring makes it pass -> the check genuinely guards the registration; WHY: prove the drift gate is real

verificationEvidence.note: npm run test:process-fact-contract passes with the new assertion that scope_contract_set gateConsumer names the parallel DEV-entry gate.
the assertion reads the ACTUAL gateConsumer registration (regex), not a constant.
NON-VACUITY PROVEN by the implementer: reverting the gateConsumer to original -> drift check FAILS exit=1; restoring -> exit=0 PASS.
